reason: The published dataset covers selected 250 m tiles in 12 cities; Manila is not listed. No TM Open Buildings polygons can be claimed for Ermita from this release, so the importer intentionally does not download unrelated tiles or create synthetic features.
next_action: Revisit only if the provider publishes Manila/Ermita coverage. If TM data are later obtained for an area, preserve the original dataset separately and spatially match individual polygons to current building footprints before transferring attributes.
attributes_described_by_source: roof material for selected individual settlement buildings
roof layout for selected individual settlement buildings
coarse building-height category for non-settlement buildings
matching_policy: No shared OSM ID is guaranteed by a standalone satellite-derived polygon. Any future matching must use polygon overlap, centroid distance, and shape checks; uncertain matches remain flagged for review.
